Tamil Nadu CM's Response to Stampede Victims' Families

Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay of Tamil Nadu has expressed regret over the Karur stampede that killed several people, and has suggested that police could have alerted him ahead of time. The government has also been criticized for not providing jobs as compensation to the families of the victims. Meanwhile, a local politician has called for restraint from the Chief Minister during his visit to meet with the families.
